editorial:
You follow a TV reporter and her cameraman into a dark apartment building after an emergency call. The doors lock, neighbors panic, and something contagious turns people violent. The found-footage style puts you right in the chaos, making every hallway feel dangerous. It is raw, fast, and scary without relying on fancy effects. The small setting keeps the fear close and personal, and the mystery grows with every floor.

The cast sells the panic, the camera work keeps tension high, and the short runtime never drags. It can be shaky and dark, so motion-sensitive viewers should beware. If you like intense horror, this is a great pick. The ending also adds a nasty surprise that sticks with you. It is not for everyone, but horror fans will love it. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or buy the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the reporter and cameraman reach the top floor and find a sick girl and an old recording. They learn the infection may be linked to a strange experiment. The girl attacks, the cameraman is killed, and the reporter hides in a dark room. A creature drags her away as the camera drops, leaving her fate unclear. You realize the building was sealed to stop the outbreak.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves intense found-footage horror.
